workflows.description: initial draft, seed replay, Lean execution, critique, refinement, denoising, and transition logging.

epistemic_contract.assurance_justification: Each occurrence preserves its own generated or computed provenance; the final wrapper follows the final occurrence.
epistemic_contract.defeater_rationale: Evidence labels remain capped until native adapters and independent behavioral oracles execute.
defeaters: A structural or fake-handler run does not establish native execution, mathematical correctness, or semantic equivalence.
observations: The canonical hook registry fixes hook order, owner skills, declared outputs, and gate text.
epistemic_contract.output_meaning: The final domain-specific artifact produced by the layered draft_execute_refine_loop shell.
epistemic_contract.question: What typed artifacts and dispositions result from the declared draft_execute_refine_loop contract?
epistemic_contract.subject: The exact source artifacts and gates traversed by draft_execute_refine_loop.

reasoning_projection.description: Draft a source-anchored Lean artifact, execute it, combine independent critiques, apply a localized repair, and decide whether another cycle is due.
reasoning_projection.name: RefineLeanDraft

occurrences.rationale: Select or replay the seed and construct the first source-anchored Lean draft.
Execute the exact draft and record compiler and source-anchor evidence.
Assess mathematical meaning, preservation, logical soundness, and reference-free drift.
Assess syntax and consolidate the formal critique findings.
Assess use of applicable mathlib abstractions and imports.
Apply formal and semantic repairs, then denoise the revised candidate.
Classify the transition and state whether the revised draft is ready or must run again.

reasoning_projection.projection_scope: one complete draft, execution, critique, and localized repair episode
